title: my $2.6M morning routine...
description: welcome to a day in my life 😂 my $2.6M morning routine...

segments.text: Every morning I wake up at [music] 7:00 a.m. and the very first thing I do is I collect a saliva measurement. I swallow a pill that measures my internal body temperature. Then I measure my HRV, my techno tampon. I also measure my face using this Visia scanner, this [music] pain threshold device. I urinate on a stick, vaginal microbiome swab. This is a digital refractometer. I measure my breast size. I test my [music] sense of smell and taste. Oh, lordy.

What else am I doing here? We have a device for my pelvic floor. Measure my stool microbiome. [music] This is my happy sleep ring. Kegel. Are you exhausted? Cuz I sure am. That is a lot and it has been a really insane process getting to this protocol. I'm excited to do this so that you don't have to do it at home.
